access: one split archive, .z01 + .z02 + .zip = 52.3 GB, all parts required, open .zip with 7-Zip
notes: 434,164 unlabelled 384x384 tiles from side-scan waterfalls, coastal Catalunya, CC BY 4.0. Right modality, clean licence. NOT a blocker and not a replacement for section 22 mining -- an optional supplement for seabed VARIETY, which mining from 581 frames cannot provide. Two caveats: (1) its stated purpose is self-supervised pretraining, which needs days on multi-GPU and is out of reach on 4 GB VRAM in 3 weeks; (2) the seabed types include ARTIFICIAL REEFS and the set is unlabelled, so bulk-importing it as the natural class would teach the model that man-made structures are natural seabed -- on exactly the axis the headline metric measures. Any sampler must screen for artificial structure.
